# fix(hfp-022): create a job card from the keyboard

## Task

In `ResearchWorkbench.vue`, a researcher creates a job card by selecting transcript text with the mouse. A floating "Create Card" menu appears on `mouseup`. Keyboard users can't do this: selecting with the keyboard doesn't open the menu, and the menu can't be reached with Tab. That fails WCAG 2.2 AA (2.1.1 Keyboard).

## Parent Story

ResearchWorkbench follow-ups (found 2026-10-26).

## Blocked by

Nothing. Easier after HFP-009, which touches the same template.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A keyboard selection in the transcript (Shift + arrows, or similar) makes "Create Card" available. For example, listen to `selectionchange` / `keyup` as well as `mouseup`, or add a visible button that acts on the current selection.
- [ ] The menu can be reached and activated with the keyboard; Esc closes it and returns focus to the transcript.
- [ ] The menu has an accessible name, and the result (card created) is announced or visibly focused.
- [ ] Spec covers opening the menu without mouse events and creating a card from it.

## Suggested label

`ready-for-agent`
